title: SEPSIS: I Can Catch Your Lies – A New Paradigm for Deception Detection
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures the ability of models to detect deception by classifying text based on its topic, where one of the topics is 'religious'. This involves identifying if a deceptive text, specifically a 'lie of omission', pertains to religious matters or misrepresents religious beliefs.
findings: The paper found that its SEPSIS classifier could successfully identify deceptive content on the topic of religion, achieving an F1 score of 0.86 with the best model configuration (T5 with transformer encoder and model merging). The 'Religious' topic was also shown to co-occur with specific types of lies (e.g., speculation), intents (e.g., gaining advantage), and propaganda techniques (e.g., flag waving, appeal to authority).
